completions.reason: The patient has a history of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans with multiple recurrences and now presents with new metastases, suggesting the metastatic disease is from this primary cancer.
support_spans: excision of a dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans in the left inguinal–suprapubic region in 1998, with four local recurrences (2000, 2001, 2008, and 2009) treated surgically; she also received external radiotherapy (66 Gy) after the last excision.
